Definition: probably to be hot; figuratively, to conceive
BiblicalUsage: 1) to be hot, conceive; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to be hot, become hot; 1a2) to mate (of animals); 1a3) to be or become hot (fig. of anger); 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to conceive (sexually); 1b2) to be in heat (of animals)
